name: sallitna-workspace
description: Shortcuts for the whole project. Each app has its own package.json in frontend/ (no libraries here).

scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx --yes supabase db push
scripts.db:test: cd backend && npx --yes supabase db query --linked -f supabase/tests/rls_test.sql
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit -p .
